verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
An inquirer inquires concerning the punishment about to fall
Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel.
It is from Allah, Lord of great ascents.

verses.ar: تَعۡرُجُ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃُ وَالرُّوۡحُ اِلَیۡہِ فِیۡ یَوۡمٍ کَانَ مِقۡدَارُہٗ خَمۡسِیۡنَ اَلۡفَ سَنَۃٍ ۚ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day the measure of which is fifty thousand years.
So be patient with admirable patience.
They see it to be far off,
But We see it to be nigh.
The day when the heaven will become like molten copper,
And the mountains will become like flakes of wool,
And a friend will not inquire after a friend.
w: and a friend will not inquire

verses.ar: یُّبَصَّرُوۡنَہُمۡ ؕ یَوَدُّ الۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ یَفۡتَدِیۡ مِنۡ عَذَابِ یَوۡمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِیۡہِ ﴿ۙ۱۲﴾
verses.en: They will be placed in sight of one another, and the guilty one would fain ransom himself from the punishment of that day by offering his children,
w: they will be placed in sight of one another

verses.en: And his wife and his brother,
And his kinsfolk who sheltered him,

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ فِی الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِیۡعًا ۙ ثُمَّ یُنۡجِیۡہِ ﴿ۙ۱۵﴾
verses.en: And by offering all those who are on the earth, if only thus he might save himself.
But no! surely it is a flame of Fire,
Stripping off the skin even to the extremities of the body.
It will call him who turned his back and retreated
And hoarded wealth, and withheld it.
Verily, man is born impatient and miserly.
When evil touches him, he is full of lamentation,
But when good falls to his lot, he is niggardly.
But not those who pray.
Those who are constant in their Prayer,
And those in whose wealth there is a recognized right
[✲]For one who asks for help and for one who does not.
And those who believe the Day of Judgment to be a reality,

verses.ar: وَالَّذِیۡنَ ہُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّہِمۡ مُّشۡفِقُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۲۸﴾
verses.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord —
[✲]Verily the punishment of their Lord is not a thing to feel secure from —
And those who guard their private parts —

verses.ar: اِلَّا عَلٰۤی اَزۡوَاجِہِمۡ اَوۡ مَا مَلَکَتۡ اَیۡمَانُہُمۡ فَاِنَّہُمۡ غَیۡرُ مَلُوۡمِیۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۱﴾
verses.en: Except from their wives and from those whom their right hands possess; such indeed are not to blame;

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ابۡتَغٰی وَرَآءَ ذٰلِکَ فَاُولٰٓئِکَ ہُمُ الۡعٰدُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۲﴾
verses.en: But those who seek to go beyond that, it is these who are transgressors —
And those who are watchful of their trusts and their covenants,
And those who are upright in their testimonies,
[✲]And those who are strict in the observance of their Prayer.
These will be in the Gardens, duly honoured.
But what is the matter with those who disbelieve, that they come hastening towards thee,
w: but what is the matter with

verses.en: From the right hand and from the left, in different parties?

verses.ar: اَیَطۡمَعُ کُلُّ امۡرِیٴٍ مِّنۡہُمۡ اَنۡ یُّدۡخَلَ جَنَّۃَ نَعِیۡمٍ ﴿ۙ۳۹﴾
verses.en: Does every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Bliss?
Never! We have created them of that which they know.

verses.ar: فَلَاۤ اُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ الۡمَشٰرِقِ وَالۡمَغٰرِبِ اِنَّا لَقٰدِرُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۱﴾
verses.en: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the easts and of the wests, that We have the power

verses.ar: عَلٰۤی اَنۡ نُّبَدِّلَ خَیۡرًا مِّنۡہُمۡ ۙ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوۡقِیۡنَ ﴿۴۲﴾
verses.en: To bring in their place others better than they, and We cannot be frustrated in Our plans.

verses.ar: فَذَرۡہُمۡ یَخُوۡضُوۡا وَیَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰی یُلٰقُوۡا یَوۡمَہُمُ الَّذِیۡ یُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۳﴾
verses.en: So leave them alone to indulge in idle talk and play until they meet that day of theirs which they are promised,

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ یَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعًا کَاَنَّہُمۡ اِلٰی نُصُبٍ یُّوۡفِضُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]The day when they will come forth from their graves hastening, as though they were racing to a target,

verses.ar: خَاشِعَۃً اَبۡصَارُہُمۡ تَرۡہَقُہُمۡ ذِلَّۃٌ ؕ ذٰلِکَ الۡیَوۡمُ الَّذِیۡ کَانُوۡا یُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿٪۴۵﴾
verses.en: With their eyes cast down; and disgrace will cover them. Such is the day which they are promised.
